name: Mayor Lina
title: Mayor of Greenhaven

lines: Ah, a new face! Welcome to Greenhaven, traveler. I'm Lina — mayor, baker, and part-time settler of fence disputes.
Every great farmer, smith and adventurer in TerraGo started right where you're standing: tired, a little lost, and nearly broke.
Here — your Greenhaven Charter, so the guards know you belong. And two of my honey buns. The road takes it out of you.
Sunfield Plains lies through the south gate. The farmland there is waiting for someone with patience. That could be you.

greetings: The fountain was built by the first settlers. They say a coin tossed in brings rain to Sunfield.
Personally, I think it brings coins to whoever cleans the fountain.
Don't let the quiet fool you. Greenhaven is growing — every season brings new faces and new trouble.
Short on Energy? Eat something! Nobody tills a field on an empty stomach.
Talk to Rowan about farming, Toren about tools, and Mira about anything with a price tag.

name: Farmer Rowan
title: Farm Supplier

lines: Name's Rowan. I sell seeds and I know dirt — the good kind.
That hoe of yours has seen better decades. Still, a worn tool in patient hands beats a fine one in lazy hands.
Carrots are the honest crop. Cheap seeds, modest price. You won't get rich off them, but they'll teach you the rhythm. Your homestead is waiting at the west end of the Sunfield lane.

greetings: Your homestead's at the west end of the Sunfield lane. Till it, plant it, water it — and come back for more seeds.
Water in the morning, harvest when it's ready, and never trust a cloud that promises rain.
Quality is what separates a farmer from someone who owns a hoe. Gold-quality carrots? Now that's a conversation.
Soil stays wet for about an hour after watering. Dry soil means a crop that sits and sulks.

name: Blacksmith Toren
title: Blacksmith

lines: Hmph. Another fresh arrival with soft hands.
I'm Toren. I forge tools, blades and armor — and I repair what you break, for a fee.
Bring me ore from Irondeep once the road reopens and I'll show you what real iron looks like.

greetings: Everything breaks eventually. That's what keeps me in business.
The rockslide on the mine road? Bram swears it'll be cleared any day now. Bram swears a lot.
A +10 blade is a fine thing. A +10 blade that cost you nothing is a lie.

name: Merchant Mira
title: Market Trader

lines: Well, well! A customer — or a competitor? In Greenhaven those are often the same person.
I'm Mira. I buy low, sell high, and remember every face that haggles.
Soon these stalls open to everyone. List your goods, set your price, and let the market decide what you're worth.

greetings: The shops pay pennies. Real profit comes from other players — remember that.
Rare fish, fine ingots, gold-quality crops... scarcity is where fortunes are made.
A word of advice? Never sell the first thing you find. Learn what it's worth first.

name: Fisher Olan
title: Fisherman

lines: Shh... you'll scare the perch.
Olan. I fish. Mostly I wait, which is the bigger part of fishing.
Anyone who tells you fishing is just clicking a button has never fought a Crystal Lake pike.

greetings: The big ones bite at dawn and dusk. The really big ones bite whenever they please.
Rain makes the fish hungry. Storms make them bold.
Crystal Lake's bridge is still out. Until then, this little pond keeps me sane.

name: Miner Bram
title: Miner

lines: Bram's the name, Irondeep's the game! Well — it will be, once the road's cleared.
Copper on the upper floors, iron deeper down, and below that... things that glitter and things that bite.
Bring a good pickaxe and plenty of food. The mine eats Energy like I eat breakfast.

greetings: Floor one's safe enough. Floor twenty? Bring friends. Floor thirty? Bring better friends.
I've heard whispers of Star Metal at the very bottom. Whispers, mind you. And one very loud cave bat.
The rockslide should be cleared any day now. I've been saying that for a week.

name: Guildmaster Kael
title: Guildmaster

lines: Welcome to the Guild Hall. I am Kael, keeper of the guild registry.
Alone, a player can farm, mine and fight. Together, a guild can topple a Stoneheart Golem and hold the market.
When you've made a name for yourself — and saved enough for the charter fee — come back and found a guild of your own.

greetings: The strongest guilds aren't the ones with the best fighters. They're the ones where the farmers feed the fighters.
The Ancient Wyvern of Dragonspire has never fallen. Fifteen to twenty-five brave souls, they say, would be needed.
Trust is the rarest currency in TerraGo. Spend it carefully.

name: Gus
title: Lift Operator

lines: Name's Gus. I run the lift. Forty floors down, and every one of 'em hungry for pickaxes.
Reach floor five, ten, fifteen and so on, and I can take you straight back down there. Saves the knees.

greetings: Lift's running. Where to?
Deeper floors, better ore — and worse company. Bring food.
Floors 1–5 are copper and stone. Iron from 6, silver from 11, gold from 21. Below that... ask me when you get there.

name: Stablemaster Hana
title: Stables

lines: Hana. I keep the horses. You look like someone who's tired of walking.
Mayor Lina told me to expect you — here's a pony from the town herd. Press Z to ride, Z again to get off.
Mounts don't like fights or tight mine tunnels. Come back when you've got gold; I've faster beasts.

greetings: Faster mounts cost more — and they're worth every coin.
A pony carries a farmer; a stag carries a legend.

name: Warden Sela
title: Dungeon Warden

lines: Sela. I watch the crypt so the crypt doesn't come out to watch you.
Inside, your whole party shares one dungeon. Enter together, or your friends will follow you in.
The boss winds up big attacks — when the ground glows red under you, MOVE. Its treasure is yours once a day.

greetings: Glowing red circle? Step out of it. That's the whole lesson.
Back from the crypt in one piece? Good.

name: Scout Bjorna
title: Mountain Scout

lines: Bjorna. I scout the peaks for the Guild.
Wolves on the slopes, yetis by the frozen lake — and up north, the Frost Giant himself.
He wakes every half hour or so. Bring a crowd if you mean to fight him.

greetings: Snow's deep today. Watch your step.
Seen the giant? You'd know if you had.

name: Hunter Moss
title: Witch Hunter

lines: Moss. I hunt what hides in the mire.
Trolls by the water, lurkers in the mud, and witches in the old ruins east.
Fog's thick here more days than not. Stay on the boardwalks when you can.

greetings: Smell that? That's the swamp saying hello.
The witches brew at night. That's when they're weakest — or so I tell myself.
